Strength & Conditioning

Strength for real life

Alison has spent more than a decade coaching — from complete beginners right through to amateur and professional boxers preparing for fights.

Her focus is everyday people living a better, healthier, more balanced life. She has a special interest in training women for lifestyle and everyday strength, with dedicated options for competitive athletes.

  • 1-on-1 strength & conditioning built around your life and your goals
  • Women’s lifestyle training — strong, capable and confident
  • Athlete S&C — structured conditioning for amateur and professional boxers
  • Train face to face at Legacy Gym, Kincumber — or coached online, wherever you are
Nutrition · Coaching

Food that fits your life

Alison’s philosophy is simple: no strict dieting, no cutting out the foods you love. Balance, quality food and sustainable habits — not another plan you can’t stick to.

She works with a lot of mums and women juggling real life, and caters for men just the same — online or face to face. For fighters, she offers consultations on weight regulation and safe, structured cuts into fight week.
